brand.name: Bentley
brand.tagline: British luxury carmaker, founded 1919, part of the Volkswagen Group
brand.description: British luxury carmaker founded in 1919 by W.O. Bentley and based in Crewe, England; part of the Volkswagen Group. Since July 2025 Bentley India has been a division of Škoda Auto Volkswagen India, the official importer, with showrooms in Mumbai, Bengaluru and New Delhi.

models.name: Bentayga

items: 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 petrol with cylinder deactivation
Permanent all-wheel drive with Torsen centre differential
48V Bentley Dynamic Ride active anti-roll system
Air suspension with four ride heights
180 mm longer wheelbase than the standard Bentayga
Front Seat Comfort Specification: 20-way heated, ventilated massage seats with memory
Postural Adjust and Seat Auto Climate
Airline Seat Specification option with 40° rear-seat recline and footrest
Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
Naim for Bentley audio (1,720 W, 20 speakers) optional
Front, side-curtain and front/rear thorax airbags
Touring Specification: head-up display, night vision, adaptive cruise control
Fluted leather seats in a choice of 15 hide colours

highlights: Sold in India as the Bentayga EWB with a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8
Wheelbase 180 mm longer than the standard Bentayga
550 PS and 770 Nm; claimed top speed 290 km/h
Optional Airline Seat Specification with 40° rear-seat recline
All-wheel steering with an 11.8 m turning circle
models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (Delhi ex-showroom page, updated 17 Nov 2026). Autocar's 28 Jul 2026 article calls ₹4.20 crore a dealer-sourced post-India-UK FTA estimate and says Bentley India has not confirmed it (last recorded pre-FTA price ₹5.90 crore), so double-check with a dealer. Not included for lack of a reliable price: standard-wheelbase Bentayga (Autocar estimate ₹3.75 crore, not listed as a variant), Bentayga Speed and the Azure/Mulliner trims. Specs are from Bentley's EWB page (read via Wayback copies; live site blocks fetches): width is across mirrors; boot 380 L in the 4+1 layout. Airbag count not published. Colours are representative; Bentley offers 7 standard and 56 extended paints for the EWB.
